content: {"action":"plan","payload_json":"[{\"requirement_id\":\"req-microsoft-cloud\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-360182cbf562dcf9a8ab9c4e\",\"description\":\"Microsoft FY2025 10-K: original definition of the Microsoft Cloud metric (its component revenue streams) and the FY2025 disclosed Microsoft Cloud revenue amount and growth rate vs FY2024, with units and period context.\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"req-intelligent-cloud\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-360182cbf562dcf9a8ab9c4e\",\"description\":\"Microsoft FY2025 10-K: Intelligent Cloud segment definition (full enumeration of principal products and services, heading and qualifiers) and FY2025 segment revenue and operating income with FY2024 comparatives and growth, in millions; plus MD&A Intelligent Cloud segment results discussion.\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"req-azure\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-360182cbf562dcf9a8ab9c4e\",\"description\":\"Microsoft FY2025 10-K: definition/composition of Azure and other cloud services and its affiliation within Intelligent Cloud server products and cloud services; FY2025 disclosed growth rate (34%); and the revenue disaggregation by product/service table and MD&A segment discussion to show whether an Azure dollar amount is disclosed (parent server products and cloud services amount vs growth rate), without estimating undisclosed Azure revenue.\"}]","reason":"Plan source_evidence requirements covering Microsoft Cloud, Intelligent Cloud and Azure definitions and FY2025 metrics, including the revenue disaggregation and MD&A segment discussion flagged as missing by prior review.","requirement_ids":[]}
